cohort: 340,748 U.S. active duty service women (ADSW) aged 18 years and older
finding: The prevalence of DRA was low (0.81%) but was higher in certain subpopulations, including women aged 30-39 years, Black women, those with higher socioeconomic status, and those with overweight and obese BMI.
mod_finding: 84.53% of women with deliveries during the study period who had DRA also had a cesarean delivery.
